send_start.interpretation: B2m input delay tracks synchronous main-thread send work; R0m input starts near the timer floor while worker-side send computation is in flight.

commit_window.interpretation: R0o commit-window input delay tracks the bounded main commit; B2o commit-window delay is a scheduling-delay proxy and not pure commit cost.

two_phase_model.b2_behavior: B2 keeps compact active-context scan, tail mutation, append stream, and bounded DOM update on the main thread.
two_phase_model.r0_behavior: R0 dispatches compact active-context scan, tail mutation, append stream, and projection construction to the Worker before bounded main-thread commit.
two_phase_model.measured_proxy: P5-M setTimeout-based synthetic input task scheduled at send start.

two_phase_model.b2_behavior: B2 schedules the synthetic task immediately before bounded renderWindow commit during the main-thread send path.
two_phase_model.r0_behavior: R0 schedules the synthetic task immediately before bounded projection commit after Worker send completion.
two_phase_model.measured_proxy: P5-O setTimeout-based synthetic input task scheduled immediately before the known commit/render window.

fairness_invariants.intentional_difference: B2 and R0 intentionally differ in ownership of logical send work.

caveats: not keyboard or pointer event evidence
send-start proxy is favorable for R0 and blocking for B2 by construction
commit-window proxy tests one specific arrival phase, not random lifecycle average
B2o 28.1ms is not pure commit cost
R0 does not eliminate all main-thread blocking
